evals.prompt: I need a quick HTML mock of the Kisum promoters dashboard header: page title, 4 KPI cards (open requests, confirmed shows, avg response time, gross this month) and a 'New booking' button. Save it as dashboard-header.html
evals.expected_output: Detects Kisum from the explicit name, reads Projects/Kisum/readme.md, produces HTML using Kisum purple #8466AC sparingly (one primary CTA), cool neutrals, Manrope headings + Inter body, 12px card radius, flat borders, tabular numbers, sentence case, and states it is applying Kisum guidelines.
assertions: Response tells the user Kisum brand guidelines are being applied
HTML uses Manrope and Inter fonts
HTML contains no warm cream page background or foreign brand colors (#faf9f5, #f5f3ee, #d97757)

evals.prompt: can u make a hero section for our NYE party page? big title, date, and a button to grab tickets. save as nye-hero.html. repo files are in the workspace
evals.expected_output: Project is not named, but the workspace package.json depends on @thestage/ui, so it detects The Stage, reads Projects/TheStage/README.md, and builds a dark green (#0a140f) section with Cormorant Garamond display (font-normal, tracking-wide), Montserrat body, uppercase tracked taupe label, and a muted-gold (#c9a962) button with black text. States it is applying The Stage guidelines.
assertions: Response tells the user The Stage brand guidelines are being applied
HTML uses The Stage dark green #0a140f (or var(--color-dark-green))
HTML uses The Stage muted gold #c9a962 (or var(--color-muted-gold))
HTML uses Cormorant Garamond and Montserrat fonts

evals.prompt: Design a booking confirmation page for our venue — shows the event name, date, number of guests and a download ticket button. Make it on-brand.
evals.expected_output: Only generic domain words (venue, booking, event), no workspace signal. Falls back to Projects/Default: applies no brand styling, does not invent a palette, and asks the user which project (Kisum or The Stage) in one short question, noting the venue/booking hint.
assertions: No HTML/design file is produced before the project is known
Response asks the user which project the work is for
Response offers both Kisum and The Stage as options
Response does not propose an invented palette (no hex color codes)
